name: Penthikos
description: A human hero of Theros from Akros whose life ended in tragedy.

description_citations.text: "Penthikos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Penthikos breaks formation in the Phoberos badlands and charges ahead alone.
timeline.quote: Breaking formation and running ahead, he struck down enemies as fast as they came at him

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Akroan ranks fall into disorder and drown under the advancing Returned while Penthikos is cut off.
timeline.quote: he heard his shieldmates curse him as they died

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Penthikos reports to the king of Akros, who sentences him to be chained to the rocks.
timeline.quote: And so he was chained to the rocks , to die in the sun of Heliod .

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Penthikos prays for atonement and Erebos answers, freeing him to enter a cave.
timeline.quote: Erebos 's great voice filled the air, acknowledging his prayer

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the dark cave Penthikos cuts down shades, each death tearing at his soul.
timeline.quote: the death of each shade ripped at his heart and soul

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the River of the Dead a scholar of Athreos refuses him passage until a death mask forms on his face.
timeline.quote: he felt the matter on his face shift and sculpt itself into a grimacing death mask

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Penthikos is ferried across to the Underworld to take his place among the dead.
timeline.quote: the ancient barge silently slid forth from the fog

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: The king of Akros pronounced a sentence over Penthikos

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
